The '''1941 [[Turkish Football Championship]]''' was the eighth edition of the competition. It was held in July. [[Gençlerbirliği S.K.|Gençlerbirliği]] won their first national championship title by defeating [[Beşiktaş J.K.|Beşiktaş]] in the final.<ref>{{cite book|last=Yüce|first=Mehmet|title=İdmancı Ruhlar: Futbol Tarihimizin Klasik Devreleri (1923 - 1952)|issue=2|publisher=iletişim|pages=388–389|language=tr}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.angelfire.com/nj/sivritepe/5758/TB.html|title=Türkiye Futbol Birinciliği|publisher=Erdinç Sivritepe|access-date=7 April 2018}}</ref> For Gençlerbirliği it was the club's first title with one more to follow in [[1946 Turkish Football Championship|1946]].

The championship was held in a new format again. The champions of the three major regional leagues ([[Istanbul Football League|Istanbul]], [[Ankara Football League|Ankara]], and [[İzmir Football League|İzmir]]) and [[1940 Turkish Football Championship|1940 Turkish football champions]] [[Eskişehir Demirspor]] qualified directly for the competition. Kayseri Sümerspor, Gölcük İdman Yurdu, and Trabzon İdman Gücü qualified by winning their respective regional qualification groups. All matches of the championship were played at [[Ankara 19 Mayıs Stadium|19 Mayıs Stadium]] in [[Ankara]].

==Qualified clubs==
* [[1940–41 Istanbul Football League|1940–41 Istanbul League]] champions [[Beşiktaş J.K.|Beşiktaş]]
* 1940–41 Ankara League champions [[Gençlerbirliği S.K.|Gençlerbirliği]]
* 1940–41 İzmir League champions [[Altay S.K.|Altay]]
* [[1940 Turkish Football Championship]] winners [[Eskişehir Demirspor]]
* Adana Group winners Kayseri Sümerspor
* Samsun Group winners Trabzon İdman Gücü
* Balıkesir Group winners Gölcük İdman Yurdu
